sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def bboxes(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,ch in [('piece','B'),('gray','c'),('yellow','Y')]:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(0,63) for c in range(0,63) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        if not cells: out[name]=None; continue
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        out[name]=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),len(cells))
    return out
b0 = bboxes(current_frame)
print("before:", b0)
action(['LEFT'])
b1 = bboxes(current_frame)
print("after LEFT:", b1)
action(['RIGHT'])
b2 = bboxes(current_frame)
print("after RIGHT restore:", b2, "restored?", b2==b0)
action(['SPACE'])
b3 = bboxes(current_frame)
print("after SPACE:", b3)
rows = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
pc = [(r,c) for r in range(0,63) for c in range(0,63) if rows[r][c]=='B']
r0,c0 = min(r for r,c in pc), min(c for r,c in pc)
print("piece shape after SPACE:", sorted((r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pc))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<parameter=code>
def bboxes(fr):
    rows = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,ch in [('piece','B'),('gray','c'),('yellow','Y')]:
        cells=[(r,c) for r in range(0,63) for c in range(0,63) if rows[r][c]==ch]
        if not cells: out[name]=None; continue
        rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
        out[name]=(min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs),len(cells))
    return out
